title: T&P Activities - AJAY KUMAR GARG ENGINEERING COLLEGE

blocks.text: Road Safety Awareness Training Session at AKGEC

Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College, in collaboration with Coca-Cola (Moon Beverage Limited), successfully conducted a Road Safety Awareness Training Session on January 24, 2025. The event aimed to educate students, faculty, and staff on safe driving practices, traffic regulations, and defensive driving techniques to promote a culture of road safety.

🔹 Session Highlights: ✅ Expert-Led Training: Interactive discussions on traffic control systems, defensive driving, hazard perception, and driving in adverse conditions. ✅ Case Studies: Real-life accident case studies were analyzed to highlight the importance of road safety measures. ✅ Rules of the Road: Emphasis on key traffic rules and responsible driving habits. ✅ 500-Meter Road March: Over 100+ participants, including 15+ faculty members, staff, and students, marched from the seminar hall to the main gate, advocating for safer roads.
The session was coordinated by the Training & Placement Department, with active participation from faculty members across various departments.
A special thanks to our dedicated faculty, staff, and enthusiastic student volunteers for making this event impactful and memorable! Together, let’s pledge to make our roads safer. 🚗💨
